reports.title: Jazz Pharmaceuticals Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Guidance
section: Jazz Pharmaceuticals has updated its full-year financial guidance, as shown in the table below, including raising its full-year 2026 revenue guidance, increasing its GAAP SG&A expense guidance to include restructuring expenses, and updating its effective tax rate guidance range to reflect the impact of the acquired IPR&D expense associated with the Actio acquisition.
